issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other (Combined Utilities Fund column) 90,157.00
issues.issue: Printed label is 'Local Receipts: Other'. Calling it Utility Charges is the extractor's inference: it is the utility fund's only receipt line and no breakdown is printed. This is defensible, but it is an assumption. The original_label also adds '(Combined Utilities Fund)', which is not printed text. The same applies to detail[22].

Governmental 'other' is 19% of governmental receipts excluding transfers (22,814 / 117,469), so it is above the 10% review threshold. The printed label is 'Other' and the trimmed pages give no breakdown, so other with review is correct as recorded.

issues.extracted: Net Cash Balance only (139,995 governmental; 194,290 business-type)
issues.issue: County treasurer balances are left out of cash, as the notes say. The form prints them as a memo outside lines 24-28, so leaving them out is defensible. The project's 'county treasurer -> Cash and Cash Equivalents' rule might lead a person to include them.
